title: senecio jacobaea subsp. dunensis
intro: Senecio jacobaea subsp. dunensis, commonly known as Dun's Ragwort, is a subspecies of the Ragwort plant, which is a perennial herb native to the British Isles. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Dun's Ragwort include wound healing, anti-edema, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating minor injuries and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dun's Ragwort include sesquiterpene lactones, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
